{{Quote|Have no fear, milady. While ''Jain Havero'' lives, these devils shall not harm you!|Jain Havero, to Leia Organa|<ref name="marvel53" />}}
'''Jain Havero''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Calian]] warrior and a comrade of powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Aron Peacebringer]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shiva IV]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A boastful young man,<ref name="marvel53" /> Havero ranked among the best fighters on Shiva IV by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], although he had such prowess in battle that he sometimes became careless.<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In 3 ABY Havero&mdash;while investigating the fate of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[K'avor]] with Peacebringer, [[Kéral Longknife]] and [[Ygal Delois]]&mdash;discovered a group of outcast cutthroats menacing [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader who had crash-landed on Shiva IV. Havero and his fellows fought the bandits off and rescued Organa, who amazed Havero, who had seen precious few offworlders in his life.<ref name="marvel53" />

==Behind the scenes==
Havero first appeared in ''[[Star Wars (1977) 53|Star Wars 53: The Last Gift from Alderaan]]'', written by [[Chris Claremont]] and released in [[1981]].<ref name="marvel53" />
